done_when: A pull request that changes a file under src/forge/board_app runs the board's browser tests in its check, in Forge's own repo; and the change says what a new and an existing client repo each get
why: The pull-request check picks tests by the Python files that changed, so a change to the board's script or style files (src/forge/board_app) merges with the board's browser tests not run; the tab-in-address fix made the default branch red this way
